about: A graph database that stores linked data and answers SPARQL queries.

prs.title: Numbers outside their declared type count as invalid
prs.broken: A value like 1200 typed as a byte, which only goes to 127, was treated as a normal number and worked in arithmetic.
prs.changed: Each sized integer type now checks its range. A value outside it is handled like any other invalid value.
prs.matters: Queries now follow the SPARQL standard, so bad data no longer passes as valid numbers.

prs.title: Converting text with extra spaces now works
prs.broken: Converting a string with spaces around it, like " 7 " to an integer, gave no value at all.
prs.changed: Conversions to numbers, booleans, dates and durations now trim surrounding whitespace first, as the standard says.
prs.matters: Text from messy sources converts correctly instead of silently leaving query results empty.
